headline: FTC insulin settlement orders bar PBMs from disadvantaging low-list-price insulin
status: Settlement orders · Compliance date not stated in collected text
summary: The FTC's settlement orders with the three largest pharmacy benefit managers restrict formulary practices that disadvantage low wholesale acquisition cost versions of insulin.
Funds that contract with these PBMs may see formulary and rebate changes that affect what the plan pays and what participants pay at the counter.

affected: Health and welfare funds contracting with CVS Caremark, Express Scripts, or Optum Rx
action: Ask the PBM whether the orders change the fund's formulary or rebate terms.
timing: Before the next PBM contract review
completion: Internal note prepared for attorney decision on whether to ask the PBM.
